column2: # 中文：先排除评分 NA，再将评分映射到 x、房间类型映射到 y，得到每种房间类型一幅横向箱线图。
# English: Remove missing ratings, map rating to x and room type to y, producing one horizontal boxplot per room category.
# 中文：箱体覆盖第 1 至第 3 四分位数，中线是中位数；默认须延伸到不超过 1.5 倍四分位距范围的最远观测。
# English: The box spans the first to third quartiles and the line marks the median; default whiskers reach the most extreme observations within 1.5 IQR.
# 中文：须外点是按此规则标记的潜在异常观测，不自动等于录入错误；箱须也不总是最小值与最大值。
# English: Points beyond the whiskers are potential outliers under that rule, not automatic data errors; whiskers are not always the minimum and maximum.
# 中文：labs(fill = ...) 在没有 fill 映射时通常不会产生颜色图例；此处关键是 x/y 的数值-类别映射。
# English: labs(fill = ...) normally does not create a fill legend when no fill aesthetic is mapped; the important mapping is numeric x and categorical y.
